links.outcome: Accuracy of general-purpose LLM in BI-RADS classification of breast ultrasound versus radiologist ground truth
links.effect: Overall accuracy 19.01%; ROC-AUC 0.5-0.6 across categories; malignancy-probable categories (4b-5) akin to random chance; predictions typically 1-2 categories off.
links.quote: We found that the overall accuracy of Gemini 2.0 was 19.01% in predicting the BI-RADS classification of the breast lesions, and those of each category did not significantly differ from one another.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the diagnostic performance of a multimodal LLM (Gemini 2.0 Flash) on interpreting ultrasound images for BI-RADS classification compared to radiologist ground truth, without evaluating an implementation safeguard or clinical deployment practice.
